claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Melissa A. Benson.

Icatian Javelineers enters with one javelin counter. Activating its {T}, remove-a-counter ability is limited by summoning sickness on the turn it enters. Once activated, destroying Javelineers in response doesn't counter its already-stacked damage ability. If Javelineers has been under your control since the start of turn, tap it and remove its only javelin counter as costs to target an opposing Llanowar Elves. Even if an opponent kills Javelineers after activation, the ability normally still deals one on resolution, killing the 1/1 Elf.
